purpose: Teach: 挙げる/鋭く/有権者/流入/伝染病/地形/能動/神宮

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、業績、絶対、挙げる、絶対、社員、絶対、評価しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our team to boost performance. Seriously. Evaluate staff based on real results.
lines.style: Commanding but controlled. Sharp attack on opening word. Measured pace with deliberate pauses between demands. Authority without shouting. Slight lean forward. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場、本気で、絶対、鋭く、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're analyzing market trends sharply and moving forward with rigour.
lines.style: Respectful, careful precision. Even delivery with slight emphasis on key metrics. Professional composure. Nods slightly as if confirming commitment. Steady eye contact, no filler.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、有権者、絶対、向け、絶対、CSR、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And strengthen our CSR initiatives targeting citizens and stakeholders. I'm counting on it.
lines.style: Direct and decisive. Crisp consonants on key terms. Slightly slower on 'CSR strengthen' to let weight land. Seated upright. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、流入、絶対、増加しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing strong customer influx growth thanks to those efforts.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Slight lightness on the positive news. Measured but not stiff. A report delivered with underlying pride. Clean diction, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、伝染病、絶対、予防、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ensure health protocols are maintained across the staff. Thoroughly. I won't accept lapses.
lines.style: Stern and unambiguous. Hard consonants on 'protocols' and 'thoroughly'. Lower register, quieter than before but heavier. Leans back slightly—expectation made clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場用地の、本気で、絶対、地形、絶対、調査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently surveying the terrain for the new facility site.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Slightly slower on 'surveying the terrain'—concrete action being reported. No apology in the tone. Professional, competent. A man delivering results.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、能動、絶対、的な、絶対、提案、絶対、求めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I expect proactive ideas from the team. Don't wait for permission. Bring solutions.
lines.style: Sharp opening attack. Expectation layered with slight impatience. Medium pace, no rush but no comfort either. Sits forward slightly. The tone of someone who has seen hesitation before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、神宮、絶対、近くに、絶対、新店舗、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently evaluating a new location near the shrine for expansion.
lines.style: Smooth close. Slight warmth breaking through on the positive update. Not rushed, but easier rhythm than before. A man delivering good news and letting it breathe slightly.
